chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 0.7 hour final exam + 104.3 hours self-study
chung.Description:
This course is designed to provide a systematic introduction to and a thorough analysis of common writing assignments.

Teaching Methods: flexible. Teachers can select approaches and methods that are suitable for their class contexts.

Assessment structure:

1) On-going assessment

- Assignments 03*15% 45%

- Peer Reviews 03*5% 15%

2) Final Examination (FE) 40%

3) Final Result 100%

4) Completion Criteria:

Each assignment >0, average of 3 peer reviews >0, Final Exam Score >=4/10 & Final Result >=5/10.
chung.StudentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to take the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfil tasks given by teacher after class

- Use laptops in class only for learning purposes
chung.Tools:
- Internet

- foxit reader for PDF files

clo: *Identify 6 stages of writing a comparative essay; * identify two types of outlines for comparative essays; *review the language of comparison; *review punctuation (commas, semicolons, colons, and apostrophes); *write a comparative essay including evidence/ statistics.

*Identify 6 stages of writing a problem-solution essay; *identify two types of outlines for problem-solution essays; *review the language of problems, solutions and evaluation; *write a problem-solution essay including evidence/ statistics; *review sentence fragments, comma splices and run-on sentences.

*Identify 6 stages of writing a cause-effect essay; * identify two types of outlines for problem-solution essays; *review the language of cause and effect; *write a cause-effect essay including evidence/ statistics.

*Identify 6 stages of writing an argumentative essay; * identify two types of outlines for argumentative essays; *review the language of opinions, arguments and concession; *review the technique of writing the counter-arguments and of how to avoid overgeneralization; *write an argumentative essay including evidence/ statistics.
*Identify 5 stages of writing a summary; *practice paraphrasing; *practice vocabulary of attribution; *write a brief summary of a book excerpt.
*Identify 5 stages of writing a response paper; *practice paraphrasing; *practice vocabulary of attribution; *write a brief response to a news article.
*Characterize ethics and professionalism in writing and group work/peer review.
